description: This file declares utility functions related to the Android reference RIL, including string prefix checking, emulator detection, and QEMU modem port opening.

methods.name: strStartsWith
methods.description: Checks if a given line starts with a specified prefix.

methods.name: isInEmulator
methods.description: Determines if the current process is running inside an emulator VM.

methods.name: qemu_open_modem_port
methods.description: Attempts to open the modem port inside an emulator VM, returning -1 on failure.
